sources.title: 品安科技股份有限公司 民國107年度股東會年報
sources.locator: 主要股東名單, printed page 41; board/shareholding disclosures, printed pages 10–11
sources.note: Lists Kingston Technology first among the principal shareholders, with 9,706,529 shares and 15.93%.

sources.title: 金士頓標下力晶生產線 力成、品安受惠
sources.locator: Article body, discussion of outsourced DRAM-module production
sources.note: Reports that Kingston would outsource DRAM modules to 品安 and describes a large order; it does not establish that Kingston was 品安's largest OEM customer.

sources.title: 品安裁員及董事金士頓解任 雙利空衝擊股價重挫跌停
sources.locator: Article paragraphs describing the September 6 company briefing and Kingston's director disqualification
sources.note: Relays 品安's statement that an unnamed customer would end all outsourced manufacturing. It does not identify that customer as Kingston or establish Kingston's earlier customer rank.

sources.title: 金士頓偏向不蓋自有產能 9月進入品安董事會
sources.locator: Article paragraph beginning “金士頓是以每股12.46元”
sources.note: Contemporaneous report describes Kingston as 品安's largest corporate/institutional shareholder following its private placement investment.

search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.

Focused searches located issuer annual-report evidence for Kingston's historical shareholder rankings and its OEM relationship, plus secondary reporting on outsourced orders. No reliable evidence found in the reviewed sources ranks Kingston as 品安's largest OEM customer for a defined period; that atom remains UNKNOWN.
The original wording does not specify a period. The shareholder ranking is supported only for the stated historical dates; the current ranking is not established here.
The issuer's annual report documents Kingston's OEM relationship but gives no customer-by-customer ranking in the reviewed passages.
The 2024 report of an unnamed customer ending outsourced manufacturing does not identify that customer as Kingston and cannot be used to infer either identity or an earlier ranking.
